content_text:
While watching
The house of Sand and Fog
I was thinking about the fact that Jennifer Connelly and Ben Kingsley  have not only very different physical features (you don’t say!) but also different ways of acting and express emotions. I understood that part of the DoP work is being ready to adapt  camera movements to actors’ work on the set and each actor has a different way of acting, besides  some “trademark” (the way of smiling, a gesture, the way of moving hands, etc)  . Does these elements influence, at least in small part, the  cinematography ? I suppose  different ways of lighting the face and different camera angles to exalt some peculiar facial feature (the eyes, the mouth,  but are there other more subtle influences?
Perhaps it’s a stupid question and i expressed myself poorly and not clearly, but i don’t think (good) actors are interchangeable, so i think  somehow the shooting could reflect that , in the context of the story (i suppose shooting Connelly’s scenes in
A house of…
and in
A beautiful mind
required different approaches, just to make an example).
